description: Charge a vendor against your AgentPay wallet. The policy engine evaluates per-tx cap → monthly budget → vendor allowlist → velocity limits BEFORE funds release; the response tells you the verdict and which policy matched. status='approved' means the charge went through; status='denied' means a policy blocked it (the wallet is not affected). Use this whenever your agent decides to spend money.

amount_cents.description: Amount in USD cents. e.g. 1200 = $12.00. Must be a positive integer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key to prevent double-charging on retries. Re-sending the same key + wallet returns the prior result instead of creating a new charge.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata stored on the transaction. Useful for tagging the agent run / task that triggered the charge.

vendor.description: Vendor identifier. Domain form preferred ('openai.com', 'stripe.com'). Used for vendor allowlist matching and audit logs.

name: charge
